home.title: Shipper desk
home.sub: Everything you need before, during and after a booking with RRPL.

track.title: Track your LR
track.sub: Enter the branch code and LR number printed on your consignment note.

bookBy.title: Book by
bookBy.sub: Book before the cut-off and your load moves the same evening.
bookBy.left: left to book for today's dispatch
bookBy.indicative: Indicative times. Confirm with your branch for urgent loads.

eway.title: E-way bill and documents check
eway.sub: See whether your consignment needs an e-way bill and which papers to hand the driver.
eway.disclaimer: General guidance based on GST rules and state notifications. Confirm with your CA.

hazmat.title: Hazardous goods pre-check
hazmat.sub: Check a product by UN number before you book. Have the MSDS ready.

pickup.title: Pickup and quote request
pickup.sub: Tell us what is moving and where. Our team will call you back.

planner.title: Load planner
planner.sub: Enter your packages, pick a truck and see how the load fits.

report.title: Report a problem
report.sub: Damaged, short or late delivery? Tell us with photos and we will follow up.
report.sent: Report received. Reference {ref}. We will call you on {phone}.
